verdict.rationale: Superhuman publishes an official 'Superhuman Mail MCP' that connects the inbox and calendar to Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants for summarizing, drafting, sending and scheduling. A probe confirms the official MCP server page, and sends require explicit user approval. Missing for 10: technical setup documentation (endpoint, auth flow, exposed tool list) and independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP connection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Superhuman Mail MCP connects your inbox and calendar into Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants—so you can summarize threads, draft and send emails, and schedule meetings without jumping between apps.
You can now drive Superhuman Mail from Claude, ChatGPT, and your favorite AI tools.
Every send action requires your explicit approval, so you stay in control.
